business_problem: Insider needed a faster and more cost-effective way to localize video content for non-English-speaking audiences because traditional dubbing was too slow and expensive and subtitles delivered lower engagement.
solution_summary: Insider localized its video catalog by plugging Papercup's AI dubbing platform into existing publishing workflows instead of relying on slow studio dubbing or subtitles alone. Papercup trains and serves its speech models on NVIDIA A100 GPUs, using GPU acceleration for both model training and production voice synthesis. As clips move through the workflow, Papercup automatically translates dialogue, segments audio, generates human-sounding AI voice tracks, and routes the output through quality-control steps with human translators before release. NVIDIA Triton Inference Server is being adopted to raise synthesis throughput, simplify support for inference frameworks such as ONNX and TensorRT, and improve end-to-end latency and GPU utilization. This architecture let Insider dub back-catalog news videos quickly enough to keep content relevant while expanding distribution into Spanish, Latin American, and European channels.

data_flow: Existing Insider videos enter Papercup's dubbing workflow, dialogue is translated and segmented, AI voices are generated on NVIDIA GPU infrastructure, human translators verify quality, and localized videos are published to regional channels.
business_outcome: Insider reached hundreds of millions of additional viewers, gained 100 million views on its Spanish YouTube channel within weeks, and expanded international audience engagement with dubbed content that sometimes outperformed the English originals.
